articles.title: BMC's 30-Year PPP Plan For 490-Bed Bhagwati Hospital Faces Congress Opposition
articles.description: The BMC's proposal to hand over Borivali's 490-bed Bhagwati Hospital to a private operator for 30 years under the PPP model has triggered opposition. Congress has demanded cancellation of the tender, citing financial concerns, while the BJP has sought digital displays showing real-time availability of beds reserved for municipal patients at PPP-run hospitals.

articles.title: Six New Vehicles for Chandrababu's Convoy at a Cost of Rs 1.78 Crore
articles.description: The Andhra Pradesh government has approved Rs. 1.78 crore to purchase six Force Urbania vehicles for Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu's security convoy. Each vehicle will cost around Rs. 29.67 lakh and will be purchased through the GeM portal. The approval comes after Chandrababu reduced his convoy from 12 vehicles to four in May to conserve fuel.
